caveat: An arrow is the difference between two populations of DIFFERENT cells in a UMAP. Not a trajectory, not a velocity; its length has no unit.

axis.method: first principal component of the 2D displacement vectors, un-centred
axis.caveat: An axis in a UMAP projection, not a gene programme. It says whether responses are collinear; it cannot name a pathway. Compare the un-centred and centred variance explained before believing it: the gap between them is a common offset shared by every perturbation, which may be biology or may be a control-versus-injected batch effect.
